title: Woodland Middle School counted 228 Hispanic students in 2025-26
text:
Woodland Middle School had 228 Hispanic students enrolled for the 2025-26 school year, a 3.8% decrease compared with the prior year, data from the New York State Education Department showed.
The school registered a total of 1,122 students for the 2025-26 school year. Hispanic students made up 20.3% of the population, making them the third largest ethnic group at the school.
Located in the East Meadow Union Free School District, the school’s central office is in East Meadow.
East Meadow High School, one of nine schools in the district, had the highest Hispanic student enrollment during this period with 351 students.
New York ranks second in the nation for K-12 public education spending , with average current expenditures of $30,012 per student—nearly twice the national average of $16,526, according to the Education Data Initiative.
